name: Dragon Tomb Gate
story: The tomb keeper will open the gate if Arith takes his place.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: Mara turns toward the Archive. Arith takes the road to the Dragon Tomb. They will meet at the roofless shelter.

beforeStory.speaker: Tomb Keeper
beforeStory.text: Someone must remain at the gate. Take my place and I will let you in.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: Arith looks down the road behind him, then shakes his head.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: Arith passes the broken gate. The keeper remains beside it, with no replacement appointed.

name: Dragonbone Array
story: The Dragon asks for one more addition, then another.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: Dragon bones fill the passage. A voice from among them asks Arith to make an addition so they can move.

beforeStory.speaker: Dragon
beforeStory.text: One more. The last one did not reach far enough.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: The bones shift. Arith slips through the opening. Behind him, the Dragon asks for one more addition.

name: The Blank Archive
story: The Archive will search only for a place Mara can name exactly.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: Arith takes the road to the Tomb. Mara enters the Blank Archive. They have agreed where to meet again.

beforeStory.speaker: Ink Clerk
beforeStory.text: The exact name of the ferry, please.

beforeStory.speaker: Mara Venn
beforeStory.text: There was a white bench. One end had been repaired.

beforeStory.speaker: Mara Venn
beforeStory.text: It is what I remember. Give me my card back.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: Mara takes the card from the desk. In her own hand she writes: white bench.

name: The Thousand-Faced Scribe
story: The Scribe offers several lives, each with a complete ending.

beforeStory.speaker: Thousand-Faced Scribe
beforeStory.text: You can choose. In this one, they came. In this one, you left first. In this one, there is no ferry.

beforeStory.speaker: Mara Venn
beforeStory.text: Which one has the wet seat?

beforeStory.speaker: Mara Venn
beforeStory.text: I spread my coat on it. I remember doing that. I do not want you to finish the rest for me.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: Mara takes an unfinished sheet. A few lines describe a bench beside water. The space beside them remains blank.
